notes: Prices in JPY from SNKRDUNK. This is run5, a same-day follow-up to run4 (~12:25-12:50 JST) collected via the built-in browser pane (Claude in Chrome extension was not connected this run) at an 800x600 viewport - all click coordinates were freshly determined per card/page rather than reused from run4's 1512x790 Chrome layout. Listings filtered to 販売中のみ (for-sale only); top-20 cheapest active listings taken per grade, with a 15% cutoff above the lowest listing (threshold = lowest * 1.15) splitting them into within_15pct vs excluded_over_15pct. The site's 安い順 (cheapest-first) sort was applied via the JS native-setter workaround and verified via SCREENSHOT (not get_page_text) before extracting the top 20 - this run uncovered that get_page_text cannot detect the 'SOLD' overlay badge on listing tiles, so an early checkbox-click failure for Card 1's PSA10 listings went undetected by get_page_text (it silently returned a clean-looking price list of all-SOLD listings) and was only caught via screenshot; corrected and re-verified via screenshot for the remainder of the run. recent_completed_sales are the most recent ~15-20 sales-history entries per grade, oldest-to-newest, filtered by the 状態 grade pill on the card's 売買履歴 section. PSA10 population/gem-rate sourced from altema.jp (pokekachi) for the 5 established cards, all re-verified unchanged from run4 (same-day, ~5.5 hours earlier). image_url reused from the skill's cached table for all 11 cards (no re-fetching needed). All 6 M6a '30th CELEBRATION' cards (released today, 2026-09-16) still have zero PSA10 listings/sales and no altema.jp PSA10 population data - unchanged from run4, as expected (PSA grading turnaround takes weeks). Their A-grade markets remain extremely active on release day itself, with sales-history turnover in the single-digit-to-tens-of-minutes-old range across all 6 cards. Notable findings vs run4 (same day, ~5.5 hours earlier): (1) Card 2 (ピカチュウex SAR SV8) now shows an active BGS10 BL listing at ¥1,500,000~ (was 出品待ち in run4) - likely a single extreme outlier, not a market shift. (2) Card 4 (ゲンガーVMAX SA) PSA10 lowest price has dropped sharply, from a ~¥380,000-400,000 range in 2026/09/02-09/06 sales down to a ¥293,000 lowest active listing and ¥295,000 most recent sale now - roughly a 25% decline over two weeks; altema.jp's cached PSA10相場 (¥320,000, dated 2026/9/15) hasn't caught up with this drop yet, corroborating it as a recent move. A-grade for card 4 remains extremely thin (still just 1 active listing) and stale (last sale still 2026/06/29, unchanged from run4). (3) Card 5 (名探偵ピカチュウ プロモ) A-grade price has also dropped recently, from a ~¥35,000-38,500 range in early September down to a ¥26,500-28,000 cluster in the most recent ~24 hours of sales. (4) pokeca-chart.com index figures (both PSA10 and raw/美品) are identical to run4's, as expected since the site's data_range only advances once per calendar day and both runs occurred on 2026-09-16. psa_tier_status omitted this run (JST is Wednesday, not Monday; the weekly PSA Value-tier check runs Mondays only).
